An early departure from Ojo de Perdiz takes you to the Stone Tree in the Siloli Desert. Wind and erosion have shaped the rock into a narrow base with a broad upper section. This is where your introduction to the landscapes of the Eduardo Avaroa Andean Fauna Reserve begins.

At Laguna Colorada, you will see red and terracotta-colored water. Its color comes from microalgae and mineral deposits. The next stop, Sol de Mañana, reveals geothermal activity, with clouds of steam rising from the ground.

Continue to the Polques hot springs, with lunch along the way. Green Laguna Verde lies at the foot of Licancabur Volcano near the Chilean border. The intensity of its mineral-rich water's color changes with the wind and light.

After the natural attractions, a private transfer to Uyuni Airport is provided. In the 15-day tour, the flight to La Paz is scheduled for the following day; the transfer time and accommodation between these days are confirmed at booking. Crossing the border into Chile is not part of this route.

The 38-meter-tall Christ the Redeemer statue stands atop Corcovado, 710 meters above sea level. The monument was unveiled in 1931 after five years of construction. Brazilian engineer Heitor da Silva Costa designed the project, while French sculptor Paul Landowski created the sculptural elements. In 2012, the monument became part of a UNESCO World Heritage property as part of Rio de Janeiro's cultural landscape.

Travel up Corcovado on an ecological train through Tijuca National Park. The train passes through Atlantic Forest for approximately 20 minutes. Along the way, you may see tropical vegetation, birds and monkeys.

The summit offers a 360-degree panorama of Rio: Guanabara Bay, Copacabana, Ipanema, Maracanã Stadium and the Tijuca Mountains. Escalators and elevators serve the upper viewing area, making the route suitable for travelers of different ages and fitness levels.

## Vinicunca: the breathtaking beauty of high-altitude flora and majestic snowcapped mountains

The journey to Vinicunca, Rainbow Mountain, unfolds like a vivid painting, where striking shades of red, orange, yellow and green create a breathtaking natural masterpiece. As we climb toward Vinicunca's brightly colored peaks, spectacular views of the Andean landscape reveal nature's delicate beauty and invite us to experience its awe-inspiring grandeur. The distinctive colors of Rainbow Mountain are more than a visual delight; they tell the story of geological wonders formed over millions of years, with each layer reflecting a different chapter in Earth's history. Walking the winding trails toward Vinicunca, we are surrounded by the breathtaking beauty of high-altitude flora and the majestic presence of snowcapped mountains, making every step feel like a connection with the land.

Set out on a grand adventure to Vinicunca Rainbow Mountain. Very early in the morning, we depart by van along the Sur Valley until we reach the village of Cusipata. Breakfast. We then begin ascending a dirt road to 4,800 meters above sea level. This is the starting point of our 4 km hike, with distant views of the snowcapped peaks of the Ausangate range. Our guide will accompany us and teach us how to walk safely at high altitude. The chain of colorfully striped mountains gradually comes into view until we reach the viewpoint at 5,000 meters above sea level. Its geological formations reveal their full splendor. Vinicunca is one of the major attractions not to be missed on a trip to Peru. Free time for photographs.

## Rainbow Mountain: a treasured memory and a wonder

The Vinicunca tour does more than display nature's palette; it invites us to reflect on the powerful forces that formed this extraordinary landscape, leaving us with deep appreciation for the planet's beauty. Every moment spent on Rainbow Mountain becomes a treasured memory, reminding us of extraordinary wonders beyond the everyday world, waiting to be explored.

Your guide meets you at the hotel, after which you travel to Praia Vermelha (Red Beach). From here, the cable car ascends first to Urca Mountain and then to Sugarloaf Mountain.

The upper observation decks offer views of Leme, Copacabana, Ipanema, Leblon and Flamengo beaches, Corcovado with the Christ the Redeemer statue, the Tijuca Mountains, Guanabara Bay, downtown Rio, Santos Dumont Airport, the Rio–Niterói Bridge and Niterói.

After descending by cable car, the excursion continues through Rio de Janeiro's historic district. At the end of the program, your guide accompanies you back to the hotel.
